def _get_radial_sum(dt, bins, bin_size, autocorr):
    radial_sum = np.zeros_like(bins[:-1], dtype=np.float64)

        # integer would) so that the bin sums are exact integer counts that

        # round-off sign.
        radial_sum[i] = np.sum(
